The preparation place (or autopsy table) is where you prepare {{item|corpse}}s or {{item|zombie}}s by removing/adding body parts from/to them. Corpses placed upon the second tier preparation place will not decay at all unlike corpses left on the first tier [[preparation place]].  But more importantly, Tier II workstation reduces the chance of making a surgical error (combined with the respective perk the chance seems to become zero). 


Each autopsy table increases the {{Morgue Capacity}} by one.  See [[corpse]]s, [[zombie]]s and [[morgue]] for more information on the various morgue mechanics.

== Surgeon's Mistake ==
{| class="wikitable"
!Icon
!Label
!Description
!Notes
|-
|[[File:SurgeonMistake.png|52px|Surgeon's Mistake]]
|Surgeon's Mistake
|Your inexperience shows. - The surgery didn't go very well. You've made a mess of the body, lowering it's quality.
|Surgeon's mistakes occur randomly while removing a body part. It shows as a "body part" (see icon) that cannot be removed. The surgeon's mistake removes one additional {{Skull|White}} and adds one additional {{Skull|Red}}. To avoid such mistakes in the future, get the [[Perks|butcher perk]] and the [[Perks|surgeon perk]].
|}
